criteriaNotes.0_hash_check: pixel_sha256 computed for all five PNGs with src/harnesses/_core/object_gate.pixel_sha256; hashes recorded per item.
criteriaNotes.1_topdown_view: All five are 3/4 top+front; brazier rim ellipse and front faces correct; riser/steps are front faces under the dais top. No side/iso faces.
criteriaNotes.2_style_fit: Brazier and riser fit the v5 slate/stone ramps and outline. Steps carry speckle noise that the flat riser lacks.
criteriaNotes.3_readability_1x: Brazier reads as laid with fuel; riser makes the dais read raised. Steps read as a pale grate/panel, not steps (FAIL).
criteriaNotes.4_placement: Riser middle/L/steps join seamlessly with each other and the dais top (course joints line up at the tile seams). Brazier grounded by a soft shadow.
criteriaNotes.5_silhouette_outline: R end piece has a 1px stone sliver at x=14 rows 7-9 between joint and outline (FAIL). Others clean.

items.name: 큰 돌 화로(꺼짐, 2칸, 버들항 돌) (great stone brazier)
reasons: 3/4 correct: elliptical rim top (rows 2-7) + front bowl face, column and square foot shown front-on, no side faces.
Slate ramp lit from the left matches the 7513/7514 harbour brazier; dark outline (30,30,36) consistent; soft alpha-70 contact shadow grounds it.
At 1x in mock-gate the four braziers read as stone braziers laid with crossed logs, ready to light, not empty urns.

Minor (not blocking): the 'ash bed' (100,92,84) is mid-dark rather than pale and the bowl floor is mostly near-black (26,14,6); a few more pale ash pixels around the log ends would strengthen it further.

items.name: 돌 단 앞 턱(가운데, 1칸) (dais riser stone)
reasons: Light edge (row 4), lip, two staggered courses (joints x=5,13 / x=1,9, period 8) and dark base line (row 15): tiles seamlessly and the dais reads as a raised slab with a front face in both mocks.
Course faces are flat single-colour fills; acceptable here because the pale dais top is flat too, but see steps note about matching texture.

items.name: 돌 단 앞 턱(왼쪽 끝, 1칸) (dais riser stone L)
reasons: End outline at x=0 with a lit highlight column at x=1 (rows 5-13); the x=1 joint of the lower course is correctly absorbed into the highlight, no stubs; joins the middle piece seamlessly.

items.name: 돌 단 앞 턱(오른쪽 끝, 1칸) (dais riser stone R)
reasons: Stub: in the upper course (rows 7-9) the mortar joint at x=13 sits next to the end outline at x=15, leaving a 1px-wide sliver of stone at x=14 — reads as a stray column of pixels at the corner.

Fix: in rows 7-9 replace the joint at x=13 with face colour (119,125,134) so the last block runs x=6..14 to the outline (mirror of how L absorbs its x=1 joint), or move that joint to x=12 and leave x=13-14 as face; keep x=15 outline.
Optional: L has a lit highlight column at x=1 but R has no shaded counterpart; a (96,100,110)-ish shade column at x=14 rows 5-13 would make the end read as a corner rather than a cut.

items.name: 돌 단 오르는 두 계단(2칸) (dais steps stone)
reasons: Readability at 1x: treads (rows 4-5, 9-11) and fronts (rows 6-8, 12-14) use neighbouring light values, so in mock-gate-dais-x3 / mock-vault-dais-x3 the steps read as a lighter grainy panel/grate set into the riser rather than two steps up.

Style mismatch/noise: isolated dark (74,74,88) specks on the step fronts (row 8 x=4,10,11,16,20,22; row 13 x=7,16,24; row 14 x=7,9,16,23,24) and mid specks on treads (row 5 x=5,14,22; row 11 x=5,6,10,14,18,22,26) are noise next to the clean flat-coursed riser it sits in.

Fix: (a) give each step front the riser's front values — top 1px (146,151,158), body (119,125,134) — and each tread the pale lip values (200,208,208) edge + (165,173,178) body, so light-tread/dark-front alternates strongly; (b) add a 1px dark (74,74,88) shadow line directly under each tread nose (rows 6 and 12 already B — keep) and darken the top 1px of each front to separate it; (c) remove the isolated specks listed above or replace them with 1-2 short horizontal joints per front, staggered like the riser courses; (d) keep cheeks x=2-3 / x=28-29 but make the inner cheek line x=3/x=28 the dark (74,74,88) so the steps read as recessed between cheeks.
